"""Camera/proprioception driven controller for the single TurnOnToasterOven episode.
No simulator state or demonstrations are used. Commands are logged for the record.
"""
import numpy as np, json, os, time
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_client import Robot
from PIL import Image
r=Robot(); spec=r.spec(); cams=list(spec['cameras']); seq=0
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
q=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][4:11]); grip=-1
history=[]
def state(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
def save(label='obs'):
 global seq
 seq+=1
 path=f'/app/runs/{seq:03d}_{label}';obs.save(path)
 out=Image.new('RGB',(640,480))
 for i,c in enumerate(cams):out.paste(Image.fromarray(obs.last[c]),((i%2)*320,(i//2)*240))
 out.resize((1280,960)).save('/app/output/latest.jpg')
 np.savez('/app/output/current.npz',q=state()[4:11],eef=state()[26:29])
 print(path, 'eef',state()[26:29], 'q',state()[4:11], 'remaining',obs.meta['time_left_s'],flush=True)
def run(Q,g=None,label='move',base=None):
 global obs,q,grip
 if g is not None:grip=g
 Q=np.asarray(Q);Q=Q[None,:] if Q.ndim==1 else Q
 A=np.zeros((len(Q),13));A[:,:7]=Q;A[:,7]=grip;A[:,12]=-1
 if base is not None:A[:,8:12]=base;A[:,12]=1
 history.append(A);np.save('/app/output/actions.npy',np.concatenate(history))
 obs=r.submit('joint_position',A,cameras=cams,include_depth=True,video='none',note=label)
 q=state()[4:11];save(label)
def move(target,n=40,g=None,label='move'):
 run(np.linspace(q,target,n),g,label)
def point(cam,u,v):
 K=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(obs.meta['cameras'][cam]['cam2world_gl']);d=obs.depth[cam]
 if d.ndim==3:d=d[-1]
 z=float(d[int(v),int(u)]);p=np.linalg.inv(K)@np.array([u,v,1])*z;p[1:]*=-1
 return T[:3,:3]@p+T[:3,3]
def fk(q):
 T=np.eye(4)
 xyz=[[0,0,.333],[0,0,0],[0,-.316,0],[.0825,0,0],[-.0825,.384,0],[0,0,0],[.088,0,0]]
 rx=[0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
 for qi,p,a in zip(q,xyz,rx):
  U=np.eye(4);U[:3,3]=p;U[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('x',a).as_matrix()@Rot.from_euler('z',qi).as_matrix();T=T@U
 return T
save('start')
print('READY',flush=True)

head='''"""Recorded custom controller for RoboCasa365 TurnOnToasterOven.

This record was produced in the single live episode using only RGB, depth,
camera calibration and robot proprioception. No resets, object state,
success query, demonstrations or pretrained policies were used.

The live camera-guided controller is preserved in live_controller.py and
its numerical kinematics/calibration routines in geometry.py. After two
small calibration motions, it solved Panda inverse kinematics, approached
the lower timer knob, corrected grasp alignment using camera feedback,
and switched to an elbow-up posture for clearance. The final centered
closed-gripper wrist turn was 0.65 + 1.0 radians, followed by release and
withdrawal. The final camera image showed the timer away from OFF.

The exact generated control sequence is encoded below as linear chunks.
Each row is a 13-channel native joint_position command at 0.05 seconds.
This is the agent's own command record, not a benchmark demonstration.

Running without arguments is read-only. --replay submits the recorded
commands to an already available service; it does not reset the episode.
Do not replay into the completed live episode.
"""
import argparse
import numpy as np

'''

    robot = Robot()
    for chunk, commands in actions():
        robot.submit("joint_position", commands, dt=0.05, cameras=None,
                     include_depth=True, video="none", note=chunk["note"])

'''
